description: This file contains functions related to repairing and suggesting OAuth profile IDs, including handling legacy profiles, profile metadata resolution, and configuration updates within an authentication system.

methods.name: getProfileSuffix
methods.description: Extracts the suffix part of a profile ID after a colon, or returns an empty string if none exists.

methods.name: isEmailLike
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles an email address by containing '@' and '.' characters.

methods.name: suggestOAuthProfileIdForLegacyDefault
methods.description: Suggests a new OAuth profile ID for a legacy default profile based on various criteria such as email and last good profile.

methods.name: repairOAuthProfileIdMismatch
methods.description: Repairs mismatched OAuth profile IDs by migrating legacy profiles to new IDs and updating configuration accordingly.
